summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing for TodoShare. All 26 pytest backend tests pass (auth, todos CRUD, sharing, completion, notifications, user-isolation). All critical frontend flows pass on mobile viewport (390x844): splash redirect, login, register screen, create todo, share with another user (valid+invalid code), 'Shared with Me' listing, mark complete (line-through styling), notification feed showing 'New Shared Task', profile user_code display + copy, logout, auth persistence on reload.

issues: Console warnings: 'shadow*' style props deprecated — use 'boxShadow' (cosmetic, non-blocking).
Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' (cosmetic).

react_native_issues.issue: Expo runtime warns about non-matching package versions: react-native-screens@4.18.0 vs ~4.16.0; expo-clipboard@55.0.13 vs ~8.0.8; expo-image-picker@55.0.20 vs ~17.0.11; expo-notifications@55.0.22 vs ~0.32.17; expo-secure-store@55.0.13 vs ~15.0.8. App runs fine on web but may misbehave on native devices — main agent should run `npx expo install --check` if mobile push testing is needed.

action_items: Optional: replace deprecated `shadow*` style props with `boxShadow` to silence web warnings.
Optional: align expo-* package versions with Expo SDK 55 expected ranges (run `npx expo install --check`).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uses os.environ['MONGO_URL'] and DB_NAME directly — good (no defaults).
Backend handlers always exclude `_id` via projection — good.
JWT secret has a default fallback in code; acceptable for dev, but main agent should ensure JWT_SECRET is set in production .env.
frontend/.env uses EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (correct for Expo runtime env var convention). All API calls go through src/api.ts which prefixes /api correctly.
All interactive elements expose testID attributes. TodoCard uses dynamic testIDs `todo-checkbox-{id}` / `todo-card-{id}` — works well for E2E.
share-todo screen correctly uppercases codes and surfaces backend errors via testID='share-error' / success via 'share-success'.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (login, register screen, create todo, share valid/invalid, shared list, mark complete + toggle back, notifications, profile, logout, auth persistence, invalid login error)

seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded users (test1, alice, bob). Test created TEST_/PLAYWRIGHT_/SHARE_TEST_ todos on Bob's account; teardown fixture deletes them where possible. Some Playwright-created todos may remain (acceptable test data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend URL: https://remind-together-6.preview.emergentagent.com (env: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL). Run backend tests via `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. Frontend testID conventions: login-*, register-*, add-todo-btn, todo-title-input, todo-description-input, date-input, time-input, priority-{low|medium|high}, category-{Work|Personal|Shopping|Health|Other}, save-todo-btn, todo-checkbox-{id}, todo-card-{id}, share-code-input, share-submit-button, share-error, share-success, profile-user-code, copy-code-btn, logout-btn. Web logout/delete use window.confirm — Playwright must register `page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept())`. Tabs are navigated via `page.get_by_text('Profile'|'Shared'|'Alerts'|'My Todos')`. Mobile viewport 390x844 works.
